# TeaVM Java compiler browser assets

These unmodified browser assets are mirrored from the official TeaVM playground:

- `compiler.wasm-runtime.js`
- `compiler.wasm`
- `compile-classlib-teavm.bin`

Upstream project: [konsoletyper/teavm-javac](https://github.com/konsoletyper/teavm-javac). Its README declares Apache License 2.0 and notes that it uses OpenJDK components under GPLv2 with the Classpath Exception. The Apache license text is in `LICENSE-2.0.txt`; see the upstream README and [OpenJDK legal notices](https://openjdk.org/legal/gplv2+ce.html) for the corresponding notices and terms.

Asset source: [TeaVM playground](https://teavm.org/playground/). These files are served from this site's own origin because the upstream host does not provide the CORS header required for browser module imports from a different origin.
